evidence.official_legshow_semantics: KEIRIN/CTC guidance states the pre-race rider introduction/leg-show is an information-gathering phase in which riders display intended line formation and order.
public_live_support: Matsudo Keirin states that all races on meeting days are live streamed on YouTube and NicoNico.
Yokkaichi Keirin states its live service runs from the first-race leg-show through the final race.
Ito Onsen Keirin live-stream help explicitly states rider introductions/leg-show are included in the live broadcast.
evidence.current_limit: The inspected public text surfaces do not expose a stable structured machine-readable LEGSHOW_OBSERVED_LINE snapshot with publication timestamp and exact rider order. Video availability alone is not sufficient for automatic admission.

recommended_transport_options.name: OFFICIAL_STRUCTURED_PRE_RACE_FEED
recommended_transport_options.reason: Best provenance and reproducibility if it exists.

recommended_transport_options.name: PUBLIC_LIVE_HUMAN_ANNOTATION
recommended_transport_options.reason: Can preserve leg-show semantics if the capture is made before cutoff and annotation is explicit, but requires a separate owner/evidence gate and reproducibility controls.

recommended_transport_options.name: PUBLIC_LIVE_AUTOMATED_VIDEO_INFERENCE
recommended_transport_options.reason: Adds computer-vision error, rights/access complexity and reproducibility burden before simpler transport is proven.

scientific_rule: A public live stream establishes observability, not a calibrated line snapshot. LEGSHOW_OBSERVED_LINE remains blocked until a prespecified capture-and-annotation protocol is executed prospectively and independently verified.
